title: Show CLI output in the conversation and tolerate a phone clock behind the host
body:
## Summary

Two defects from the Android chat → CLI validation.

**Long CLI output hid the composer.** `cli_card` drew every output line as a stack child under the card, outside the scrolling transcript, so a `verse who` result pushed "Run again" and the composer off screen with no way to scroll. The output now lands in the transcript as one row (`coder-cli-out`, an `Element::Message` with `note = "openagents …"` and a single Markdown `Block::Code` child, key `coder-cli-out-md`); the card keeps only the command, place, and **Run again**. Android already renders transcript code blocks monospace and selectable, so no Kotlin change.

**Fresh invitations refused as expired.** `coder_connect::protocol::fresh` rejected `issued_at > now`, so a phone ~2 s behind the host saw a just-minted invitation as "not current". It now admits `issued <= now + CLOCK_SKEW` (60 s); `expires <= now` stays strict, so genuinely expired artifacts are still refused. `coder-access` delegates to this function, so host enrollment gets the same tolerance; the host's own record bounds (`enroll.rs`) are unchanged.

Checks: `cargo test -p coder-connect --lib fresh_tolerates`, `cargo test --manifest-path crates/openagents-mobile/Cargo.toml --lib coder_tab` (25 pass), clippy clean on both, fmt.
